autor: set before the batch was launched
estado_no_momento_da_gravacao: 10 of the 80 runs of batch A3 completed (rc=0); NO .npz prediction or test metric was read by anyone before this record was written (only the driver log: 'OK em Ns'). The criterio_A3.json of the execution step covers execution/provenance and deferred the analysis; this file fixes the analysis.
alegacao: A4 (deflation/inversion under sentinel target; approximate GNN×MLP parity on the sentinel) and input to A3 (distributions across seeds)
unidade_de_analise: cell (8) × training seed (5); GNN−MLP contrast paired by seed within the cell; the city is the unit of inference across cells (EV-5); no sign test across cells
metricas: RSSI MAE (channel 3) on the held-out test set, per population: valid (target[:,0] < 299), sentinel (>= 299), all; computed from the .npz predictions (physical pred via fisico()); also PL MAE (channel 0) on the valid nodes

H1_paridade_sentinela.estatistica: median across the 5 seeds of (MAE_sent_GNN − MAE_sent_MLP) per cell
H1_paridade_sentinela.tolerancia: data-derived, per cell: SD across the 5 seeds of the MLP MAE_sent in the cell itself (the MLP is deterministic given the seed; the SD measures the recipe dispersion). If dp_MLP < 0.01 dB, use the GNN SD. The tolerance is recorded per cell BEFORE reading the contrast.
H1_paridade_sentinela.aceite: approximate parity if |median| <= tolerance in >= 6 of the 8 cells; otherwise, 'systematic difference' with the sign and magnitude reported
H1_paridade_sentinela.proibido: fix 0.05 dB or 0.25 dB a priori (v2); report 'consistent in direction' without counting the seeds

contraste_GNN_menos_MLP: distribution per cell: median, min, max, number of seeds with negative sign (GNN better) out of 5; in the three populations; no aggregated magnitude across cells as a result (description only)

regras_gradscaler.acao: a flagged run enters the distribution with a mark; if > 20 % of the runs of a cell are flagged, the cell is reported separately

regras_canal_1.R-c0: no target outside the clamp range (precondition)
regras_canal_1.R-c1: among targets > 0: <= 1 % outside the range and P99 of the excess <= 5 dB
regras_canal_1.R-c3: GNN−MLP contrast with the same sign with and without clamp
regras_canal_1.nota: channels 1–2 are auxiliary components derived from the terrain (generator); no number in the article depends on them; rules only flag

nao_determinismo: A2/A2c showed the GNN to be non-deterministic with the same seed (Δ up to 0.13 dB in the aggregate MAE); no individual run is citable; only distributions across seeds; checkpoint selection (best epoch on validation) is part of the variance
proveniencia: all 80 with insumos.sha256_rf_data = manifest v4 and identical test-partition hash within the cell; a run with rc=3 is a finding, not data
votos: 3 independent recalculations per number before any claim; the aggregation script (v3_A3_agregar.py, to be written) is re-run independently and read in full
